source: (Matthaia 7:13) Pahnihnaah, Setana lama ṭangte chuan hlâwkna tlêmtê chauh an hmu tih kan hria.
reference: (Matthew 7:13) Second, we learn that those who join Satan get only limited benefits.
hypothesis: (Matthew 7:13) Secondly, we know that those who side with Satan find only a small reward.
raw_text: (Matthew 7:13) Secondly, we know that those who side with Satan find only a small reward.

source:
Vânte u, hlim ula, aw leilung, nang pawh lâwm rawh,
Lalpa hi lal a nih hnam tin hrilh rawh u.
reference: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice; And let them say among the nations, Jehovah reigneth.
hypothesis:
O heavens, be joyful; O earth, rejoice;
Tell all nations that the Lord is King.
raw_text:
O heavens, be joyful; O earth, rejoice;

source:
Ngil i neih êm avângin min tiharh la,
I thu hriattîr ka zâwm dâwn nia.
reference: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; So shall I observe the testimony of thy mouth.
hypothesis: Please let me know if you have any doubts, and I will provide further information.
raw_text: Please let me know if you have any doubts, and I will provide further information.

source: Chutianga tihnaah chuan mihring hlui hlîp a, mihring thara inthuam tûra beih chhunzawm zêlna a tel a ni.
reference: This involves continuing to work at putting away the old personality and putting on the new.
hypothesis: In that sense, it includes the passing away of the old man and the continued preparation of the new man.
raw_text: In that sense, it includes the passing away of the old man and the continued preparation of the new man.

source: Tichuan Sihona leh a mite zawng zawng chu Jahaz-a min bei turin an lo thawk a.
reference: Then Sihon came out against us, he and all his people, to fight at Jahaz.
hypothesis: Then Sihona and all his people came to attack us in the ship.
raw_text: Then Sihona and all his people came to attack us in the ship.
